name: mcp-client
description: Connect to allowlisted remote MCP servers over Streamable HTTP, discover their tools, complete OAuth device authorization, and make explicit confirmed tool calls with chat-scoped profiles.

REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS.prompt: Maximum duration of one MCP request in milliseconds.

MAX_RESULT_BYTES.prompt: Maximum accepted MCP result size in bytes.

ALLOW_PRIVATE_HOSTS.prompt: Allow private or loopback MCP server addresses. Keep false unless explicitly required.
